description: Decides whether to repair (or rebuild) a machine or replace it, by comparing cost per hour. The repair is priced by the hours it buys before the next major event. Uses the method on torgix.ai/learn/repair-rebuild-or-replace. Give the replacement either as a cost per hour or as a purchase price. For a rebuild, enter the rebuild cost and the much larger hours it buys.

current_operating_cost_per_hour.description: What it costs to operate per hour today (fuel, repairs, wear)

current_value.description: What the machine is worth today

hours_repair_buys.description: Hours the repair should run before the next major event (use the low end of the shop's range)

repair_cost.description: Repair or rebuild quote in US dollars

replacement_cost_per_hour.description: Total cost per hour of the replacement, if known

replacement_operating_cost_per_hour.description: Replacement's operating cost per hour (default: same as today's machine)

replacement_price.description: Purchase price of the replacement, if the cost per hour is not known

replacement_residual_value.description: Replacement's expected resale value (default 30% of price)

value_after_those_hours.description: What it would be worth after those hours

name: repair_rebuild_or_replace
title: Repair, rebuild or replace
